func:
/*
 * PR Champion Structure Diagnostics
 * READ ONLY
 */

const model =
    flow.get("pr_champion_model") || null;

function describe(value) {
    if (value === null) {
        return {
            type: "null"
        };
    }

    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        return {
            type: "array",
            length: value.length,
            first_item_keys:
                value.length > 0 &&
                value[0] &&
                typeof value[0] === "object"
                    ? Object.keys(value[0])
                    : null
        };
    }

    if (typeof value === "object") {
        return {
            type: "object",
            keys: Object.keys(value)
        };
    }

    return {
        type: typeof value,
        value: value
    };
}

if (!model) {
    msg.payload = {
        ready: false,
        reason: "CHAMPION_MODEL_NOT_LOADED"
    };

    return msg;
}

const active =
    model.models &&
    model.models.CMD26_ACTIVE_F
        ? model.models.CMD26_ACTIVE_F
        : null;

const idle =
    model.models &&
    model.models.CMD26_IDLE_C
        ? model.models.CMD26_IDLE_C
        : null;

msg.payload = {

    ready: true,

    artifact: {
        keys:
            Object.keys(model),

        schema:
            model.schema || null,

        artifact_version:
            model.artifact_version || null,

        status:
            model.status || null
    },

    root_training_rows:
        describe(model.training_rows),

    models:
        describe(model.models),

    CMD26_ACTIVE_F: {
        structure:
            describe(active),

        features:
            active &&
            active.features
                ? active.features
                : null,

        target:
            active
                ? active.target
                : null,

        k:
            active
                ? active.k
                : null,

        condition:
            active
                ? active.condition
                : null,

        training_rows:
            active
                ? describe(active.training_rows)
                : null,

        row_indexes:
            active
                ? describe(active.row_indexes)
                : null,

        training_indexes:
            active
                ? describe(active.training_indexes)
                : null,

        indices:
            active
                ? describe(active.indices)
                : null
    },

    CMD26_IDLE_C: {
        structure:
            describe(idle),

        features:
            idle &&
            idle.features
                ? idle.features
                : null,

        target:
            idle
                ? idle.target
                : null,

        k:
            idle
                ? idle.k
                : null,

        condition:
            idle
                ? idle.condition
                : null,

        training_rows:
            idle
                ? describe(idle.training_rows)
                : null,

        row_indexes:
            idle
                ? describe(idle.row_indexes)
                : null,

        training_indexes:
            idle
                ? describe(idle.training_indexes)
                : null,

        indices:
            idle
                ? describe(idle.indices)
                : null
    }
};

return msg;

initialize:
/*
 * PR-ARB.4D.3C
 * Immediate Safe Gate Initialization
 *
 * Executed when this Function node starts.
 *
 * No MQTT OUT
 * No actuator
 * No authorization restoration
 * No snapshot restoration
 */

const now = Date.now();

const GATE_SCHEMA =
    "domopi.predictive_reserve.arbitration_gate.v1";

/*
 * Persistent kill-switch is the only value
 * allowed to survive restart.
 *
 * Missing / invalid => OFF.
 */
const storedControl =
    flow.get("pr_control_enabled", "file");

const controlEnabled =
    storedControl === true;


/*
 * Never inherit runtime authority/snapshot
 * from the previous node generation.
 */
context.set(
    "last_pr_operational_state",
    null
);

context.set(
    "last_arbitration_snapshot",
    null
);


/*
 * Immediate safe projection.
 *
 * OFF:
 *   consumer sees BYPASS.
 *
 * ON:
 *   consumer sees PR enabled but SHADOW /
 *   no effective authority => fail-closed.
 */
const safeGate = {

    schema:
        GATE_SCHEMA,

    updated_at_ms:
        now,

    control_enabled:
        controlEnabled,

    operating_mode:
        "SHADOW",

    authority_allowed:
        false,

    effective_authority:
        false,

    snapshot:
        null,

    safety: {

        projection_only:
            true,

        pr_only_writer:
            true,

        actuator_path:
            false,

        mqtt_out:
            false,

        ai_climate_modified:
            false,

        startup_safe_projection:
            true
    }
};


/*
 * Memory only.
 */
global.set(
    "pr_arbitration_gate",
    safeGate
);


node.status({

    fill:
        controlEnabled
            ? "yellow"
            : "grey",

    shape:
        "ring",

    text:
        controlEnabled
            ? "PR ON / SHADOW startup"
            : "PR OFF / BYPASS startup"
});
